name: EXPBG CDF Compat
description:
# EXPBG CDF Compat

- Garrisons, Full-cached squads and cache zones are saved in CDF Game Master Save files and restored on load.
- Intel items, server racks and USB drives keep their contents.
- Unit Dialog lines, AI Global Skills settings and combat modes are kept.
- Surrender prisoners and ACE captives are saved and come back as prisoners after a load.
- Vehicle crews, gunners and seated soldiers (chairs too) keep their seats.
- Unit Scripts (Hold, Freeze, ambient animations) are kept on their spots.
- Soldiers get back the items CDF's own inventory restore loses.
- Ambient Destruction scenery and building damage are kept.
- Requires: EXPBG GM Tools (FC1402F65B2F4A45) and CDF Game Master Save (6A1876F37D65AB09).
summary: CDF Game Master Save support for EXPBG GM Tools: garrisons, unit caching, intel items, dialog, AI skills, surrender and destruction in CDF saves.
